Snapshot restore tile that parses manifests, loads accounts, and rebuilds txncache state.

# Purpose
`fd_tile_snapin` implements a snapshot ingestion tile. It reads a snapshot stream, parses control and data fragments, and loads account state into `fd_accdb` through `fd_funk`. The tile handles both full and incremental snapshots, tracks state with a small state machine, and publishes control and manifest messages to the next stage in the pipeline through `fd_stem`. It also records metrics for bytes read, accounts inserted, and current state.

The file also rebuilds the transaction cache from snapshot manifest data. It parses the manifest, slot delta data, and blockhash queue data, then creates the fork chain in `fd_txncache`, attaches blockhash values, inserts transaction hashes, and finalizes the fork root used by later queries. It verifies snapshot data against slot history and bank slot limits, detects malformed input, and moves the tile to an error state when validation fails. The file defines the tile entry point `fd_tile_snapin`, plus the scratch layout, seccomp policy, and initialization code needed to run the tile in the runtime.
